title: Pizza Quiche
directions: Fry sausage & onion. Place in bottom of 9" deep dish pie crust.
Put on tomato paste & oregano.
Mix eggs, milk, cheese tog. & pour over all.
Bake @ 425° for 10 min then reduce to 350° - 35 min.
Serves 4-6

title: Herbed Oven Potatoes
raw_text:
Herbed Oven Potatoes    (re Deane H.)
1/2 c olive or vegetable oil
1/4 c butter or marg melted
1 envelope onion soup mix
1 tsp. dried thyme
1 "  " marjoram
1/4 " pepper
2 lbs. red potatoes quartered
minced fresh parsley.
                        over directions

title: Herbed Oven Potatoes
directions: In a shallow bowl, combine the 1st. 6 ingred.. Add potatoes, a few at a time; toss to coat.
Place in a single layer in a greased 15 x 10 x 1" baking pan. Drizzle c remaining oil mixture.
Bake uncovered @ 450° for 50-55 min. or until tender, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle c parsley.
Yield: 6 servings

title: Seafood Casserole
directions: Mix all except for chips. Put in 11 x 7" casserole.
Cover & refrigerate. Crush chips, put on top. Bake for 30-40 min uncovered until hot throughout.
Can be made ahead - (improves flavor). Can be served cold s baking.
notes: 's baking' = without baking (Grandma's medical shorthand: s-bar = without)
raw_text:

1 c chopped green pepper        1 c. chopped onions
2 c real mayo                   2 c. chopped celery
1 - 6 oz pkg. frozen shrimp (defrosted)   1 - 4 1/2 oz can crabmeat
1 tsp Worchestershire sauce.    1 - 5 oz can lobster
- dash tabasco                  1 - 7 oz " solid tuna

title: Herb Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 tsp (2 mL) dry basil leaves, crushed
1/4 cup (50 mL) fine dry bread or cornflake crumbs
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Cook Creamette macaroni according to package directions.
Melt 1/4 cup (50 mL) butter in medium saucepan. Blend in flour, mustard, salt, basil and paprika. Gradually stir in milk. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil and thickens.
Remove from heat. Add cheese; stir until melted. Stir in cooked macaroni. Spoon into a greased 1 1/2-qt (1.5 L) baking dish.
Combine crumbs and melted butter; sprinkle over casserole. Bake 20 min or until hot. Garnish with parsley. Makes 6 servings.
notes: Printed bilingual (English/French) recipe from a Creamette macaroni package; French column cut off at right
Same recipe as handwritten card in photos 292-293

directions: Cook noodles as directed. Drain. Line bottom of 9 x 13 pan.
In med. bowl mix cottage cheese, egg & onion salt tog. Spoon over noodles & spread. Cover c layer of noodles.
In same bowl, mix cheddar cheese c potato, salt, onion salt & pepper. Spread over noodles. Cover c layer of noodles.
Melt butter in fry pan. Sauté onions slowly till clear & soft. Pour over noodles. Cover. Bake 30 min in 350° oven.
Let stand 10 min ac cutting. Serve c sour cream.

ingredients: 4 slices of bacon cut in little pieces
directions: Cook 4 slices of bacon cut in little pieces.
Cut chicken in pieces, brown in frying pan c 2 cloves of garlic & 1 small onion chopped.
Cook brown rice & place around sides of casserole dish. Place cooked chicken in center of casserole dish.
Top c peach & pear halves & pineapple rings. Top c toasted slivered almonds.
Bake in 350° oven for 25 min.

title: Mom's Easy Bean Bake
ingredients: 2 1/2 c dry great northern beans (about 1 lb.)
directions: Place beans & salt in pan, cover c H2O. Bring to a boil. Boil for 2 min. Remove from heat; cover & let stand 1 hr. Drain, reserve liquid.
Combine beans, 1 c liquid & remaining ingred. in a greased 2 1/2 qt. bk. dish. Cover & bake @ 350° for 1 1/4 hrs.
notes: Continues on back (photo 300): '...or until beans are tender. Stir occasionally. Add additional reserved liquid if needed. 8-10 servings'
raw_text:
Mom's Easy Bean Bake.
2 1/2 c dry great northern beans (about 1 lb.).
1 tsp salt
1 lb. sliced bacon, cooked & crumbled.
1 c packed brown sugar.
3 tbsp. molasses.
3 sm. onions chopped.
Place beans & salt in pan, cover c H2O. Bring to a boil. boil for
2 min. Remove from heat; cover & let stand 1 hr. Drain,
reserve liquid. Combine beans, 1 c liquid & remaining ingred.
in a greased 2 1/2 qt. bk. dish. Cover & bake @ 350° for 1 1/4 hrs.
